delivery.description: The delivery ULID. Matches X-Tmesis-Delivery. Duplicated in the body so a receiver that logs bodies has the dedupe key without the headers.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC, when the event happened on the node. ORDER BY THIS, never by arrival: delivery is unordered.

session.description: The session this recording belongs to (one file, one session, as built). Correlate on recording_id.

artifact.description: The two are registered separately and retained separately. A receiver that merges them loses the distinction between the insurance copy and the as-aired program.

destination.description: Where the artifact is durable. Told, never derived. This is the location a control plane attaches: the absolute path after a copy to a directory, the node's local path when no destination was configured (then it equals local_path), or, for a destination_ref recording, the location of the told plan target whose completion registered it (the transfer executor, since v0.5.0).

container.description: The container as delivered. Always mpegts or flv for the ingest artifact (final plan 11.34 D1); mp4 for the told master.

local_path.description: The node's copy. Since v0.5.0 it is retired only once retention_expires_at has passed AND an explicit release, override or discard names its generation, never on registration alone and never on this delivery's acknowledgement; when destination equals this path, a release is the decision to remove the only copy. A recording finalized before v0.5.0 (generation null) is never retired by the node.

generation.description: The recording's artifact generation, the id the /artifacts routes key on. Null only for a registration with no artifact row.

registered_at.description: When registration was confirmed. retention_expires_at counts from HERE, not from finalize.

source_generations.description: The told master's source generations (recording_ingest) in join order. Always [] for the ingest artifact.
